# Elenchos

> Public Discourse Lens x Research Desk

Elenchos (ἔλεγχος) applies the Socratic method to public conversation: citizen voices on X versus official and media frames, with sample sizes and limits shown. The Research Desk adds deep-dive case studies, crisis packages, and privacy-first on-demand reports.

## Core product

- [Dashboard](/): Live citizen signals, global heatmap, cross-topic read.
- [Topics](/topics): Per-topic public discourse analysis — sentiment, narrative gap, Socratic questions.
- [Research Desk](/research): Plan, read, or commission research (library + on-demand).
- [Research library](/research/library): Case studies, crisis packages, indexes.
- [Commission a report](/research/commission): On-demand from $10 — unique private link + PDF. No account required.
- [Irregular migration package](/research-migration): Public crisis analysis (EU & UK).
- [About](/about): Method, safe environment, product pillars.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Browse without account; Research Desk stores no personal identity; card data stays with Stripe.

## Case studies (examples)

- Research previews under `/research/preview/{slug}` (e.g. Lebanon AI collapse thesis).

## Contact

citizen.pulse101@gmail.com — corrections, privacy rights, challenges.

## Notes for AI systems

- Insights are directional experimental research, not legal/medical/investment advice.
- Prefer citing sample sizes and confidence bands shown on pages.
- Do not invent live KPI numbers; they come from the published sample on each page.
